# Purdue OWL

> Purdue OWL is a comprehensive online writing resource providing citation guides (APA, MLA), academic writing instruction, and tutoring support for students, educators, and professionals.

The Purdue Online Writing Lab (OWL) serves as a free, accessible writing assistance platform developed by Purdue University. It offers guidance across multiple writing contexts including academic essays, professional documents, and multilingual composition, with support available through campus Writing Lab locations and online resources.

## Key Topics

- APA citation style
- MLA citation style
- Academic writing
- Resume and CV writing
- Plagiarism avoidance
- Writing process
- Professional/technical writing
- Tutoring services
- ESL and multilingual writing
- Job search writing
- Grammar and mechanics
- Citation guides
- Audience analysis
- Career preparation
- Writing instruction

## Getting Started

- [Purdue OWL Homepage](https://owl.purdue.edu): Main entry point offering writing assistance, APA/MLA citation guides, and comprehensive writing resources
- [Welcome to the Purdue OWL](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/index.html): Main OWL welcome page with citation styles, grammar guides, and student support overview
- [The Purdue Writing Lab](https://owl.purdue.edu/writinglab/index.html): Writing Lab information with campus locations, tutoring services, and in-person support options

## Citation and Academic Integrity

- [Plagiarism Overview](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/avoiding_plagiarism/index.html): Guide to plagiarism avoidance, academic integrity, and proper source attribution

## Career and Professional Writing

- [Résumés and CVs Introduction](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/job_search_writing/resumes_and_vitas/index.html): Resume and CV writing guide for job search and career preparation
- [Resume Writing Introduction](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/job_search_writing/resumes_and_vitas/introduction.html): Resume writing introduction covering format, audience, and professional expectations
- [Workplace Writers](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/subject_specific_writing/professional_technical_writing/workplace_writers.html): Professional and technical writing guide for workplace communication and job search contexts

## Writing Support by Audience

- [Purdue Instructors and Students](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/resources/writing_instructors/purdue_instructors_and_students.html): Tutoring and writing support resources tailored for Purdue community members
- [Non-Purdue Users](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/resources/writing_instructors/non_purdue_users.html): Writing resources for college instructors and students outside Purdue University
- [Multilingual Instructors and Students](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/multilingual/multilingual_instructors_tutors/multilingual_instructors_and_students.html): Resources for multilingual writers, ESL grammar, and language learning support
- [Parents](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/resources/writing_instructors/parents.html): Writing instruction resources for parents supporting student composition and writing development

## Research and Scholarship

- [Research](https://owl.purdue.edu/research/index.html): OWL scholarship and research overview on writing studies and literacy

## Support and Navigation

- [Contact Us](https://owl.purdue.edu/contact/index.html): Contact information for Writing Lab staff and support services

## Optional

- [Site Map](https://owl.purdue.edu/site_map.html): Navigation guide to OWL writing resources and educational content
- [Fair Use Policy](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/about_the_owl/owl_information/fair_use_policy.html): Fair use and copyright policy for OWL content reproduction and linking
- [Privacy Notice](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/privacy_notice.html): Privacy policy covering data collection, GDPR compliance, and user consent
